plan_name: Medicare Advantage Standard Evidence-Based Pre-Surgical Diagnostic Policy
covered_indications: Pre-operative evaluation in patients with documented cardiopulmonary history or high surgical risk index

clinical_criteria.description: Documented American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) class score II or greater
Absence of prior unexpired chest radiograph within past 90 days

exclusions: Unconditional routine screening in asymptomatic ASA Class I patients without cardiac/pulmonary comorbidities
statutory_notice: ANVESH evidence outputs are assistive decision-support tools. Final authorization requires explicit licensed human review.
